about: Questions nemo's ask lane sends to the connector's search, and the units a right answer comes from. A question is a hit when a chunk of any expected unit is in the top k (nemo fetches the top 4, ~/work/nemo src/nemo/ask.py EXCERPTS). Units, not chunk ids, so the set survives a release that renames headings. Run: python3 tools/eval_search.py <data dir>.
